items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1965-09-13
items.q: The name 'Charlie' appears exclusively as a form of address by the Interviewee to the Interviewer (e.g., 'Well, at the time that I was coming up, Charlie...'). There is no mention of a third person named Charlie.

ctx.x: There's someone near the channel now, don't you? There's someone near the Irish channel?
Well, at the time that I was coming up, Charlie, no, I don't believe that that was the Irish channel around that section. The Irish channel was more in the uptown section.
But you mean now, don't you live around close to the channel?
